title: Show the hostname
description: Show the hostname of the system. Warning: the hostnamectl set-hostname examples rename the machine and need root.

examples.description: Show the FQDN with verbose output (-v)

notes: hostnamectl is recommended on systemd for permanent changes. Changing the name requires root (sudo).
